purpose: Teach: 消す/素早く/ニコニコ/いやあ/真っ黒/鞄/懐かしく/セーター

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、お風呂の電気、本気で、絶対、消す、絶対、のを、絶対、忘れたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your dad would forget to turn off the bathroom light every single time — you remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. Warm chuckle underneath. Slow, deliberate pacing as if turning over an old memory. Slight upward lilt on the question, inviting her back into the moment with him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、素早く、絶対、対応されたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh, I do. Your father was always so quick to notice those things, wasn't he? I remember that about him.
lines.style: Affectionate, settled tone. Soft smile in the voice. Leisurely pacing — no rush. She's meeting him in the memory, not correcting him. Gentle warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、ニコニコ、絶対、笑ってくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: And when you were young, your gran would smile at your dad about it, wouldn't she? Do you remember?
lines.style: Softer now, almost wistful. A slight catch in the throat like he's seeing her young face again. Quiet wonder. Trailing off gently at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: いやあ、若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、よく頑張られたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes. Your grandfather worked so hard in those days, didn't he? I remember watching him do it all.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment with underlying affection. She's following his lead but adding her own thread. Unhurried, the cadence of long marriage speaking to each other.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、お靴、絶対、真っ黒、絶対、磨いてくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Your gran used to polish your father's shoes until they gleamed black — do you remember that?
lines.style: Drawing the memory out slowly. Specific and tender. Voice brightens slightly on the image of the shoes. Slight wonder that such small devotions happened at all.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、革の、絶対、鞄、絶対、大事に、絶対、なさったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: He took such care of his leather bag in those days, didn't he? That beautiful bag. I remember.
lines.style: Nodding along in agreement, but she's adding her own remembered detail. Warm specificity. Voice settles on 'bag' like it's a small treasure in itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、おばあちゃんの、絶対、お写真、絶対、懐かしく、絶対、ご覧になってたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: And your gran — she used to look at photographs of her mother with such longing. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Quieter now, almost reverent. The memory of watching someone grieve — it moves him. Slow, respectful pacing. Pause before 'longing' like he's feeling it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、ばあさんに、絶対、セーター、絶対、編んでもらったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes. Your grandfather asked your gran to knit him a sweater in those days, and she did. Such care she put into it.
lines.style: Tender recollection with a note of admiration. She's remembering not just the sweater but the asking, the doing. Warm, unhurried. Voice settles on 'sweater' like it still matters.
